articles.summary: 题名表明研究主题是全固态电池在阴极传输约束下的快速充电优化。作者来自UM6P Vanguard Center及Université Côte d’Azur等机构，说明这是一篇学术论文。若该问题得到有效解决，可能有助于提升充电速度并理解阴极传输限制，但当前材料不足以确认具体方法与性能。

articles.sourceExcerpt: Optimal Fast Charging of All-Solid-State Batteries under Cathode Transport Constraints Mustapha Bouchaara 1,∗, Abdessamad Belfakir 1, Abderrahmane Habbal 1,2, and Ahmed Ratnani 1 1UM6P Vanguard Center, Mohammed VI Polytechnic University, Benguerir 43150, Morocco 2Université Côte d’Azur, Inria, CNRS, LJAD, UMR 7351, Parc Valrose, Nice Cedex 2, 06108, France ∗Corresponding author:mustapha.bouchaara@um6p.ma abdessamad.belfakir@um6p.ma;abderrahmane.habbal@univ-cotedazur.fr; ahmed.ratnani@um6p.ma Abstract Fast charging of all-solid-state batteries is limited by solid-state transport in the positive electrode, which can generate substantial concentration nonuniformity under aggressive charging. We formulate fast charging as a minimum-time boundary-control problem for a one-dimensional cathode diffusion model, subject to a terminal average-concentration target and a path constraint on the bulk-to-surface concentration difference. For constant diffusivity, we prove existence of a global minimizer and show that every minimum-time policy is maximal-feasible: the charging rate remains at its upper bound until the transport constraint becomes active and subsequently follows the active boundary.

articles.title: Show HN: Mcpsnoop – Wireshark for MCP (transparent proxy and live TUI)
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + HN discussion
articles.summary: 这是一个把 MCP（模型上下文协议）通信流量抓取并可视化出来的开发者工具，形态是透明代理加实时终端界面，定位类似网络协议分析里的 Wireshark。它出现在 Hacker News 上，拿到 64 分和 22 条评论，说明 MCP 生态里已经有人开始为“看不见的调用链”做调试基础设施。值得关注的是这类工具往往先于商业价值出现：它们衡量的是一个协议是否真的被大规模使用。
articles.failureAnalysis: 它能否成立几乎完全取决于 MCP 本身的普及度，如果 MCP 只是某一家厂商的阶段性方案，工具的用户池会一直很小。作为开发者调试工具，付费意愿低、客单价低，靠开源获客后如何变现是明确难题。协议本身仍在演进，解析逻辑要持续跟进，维护成本会随时间上升，而官方或平台方内置类似抓包能力时，第三方工具最容易被替代。透明代理还要接触凭证和上下文数据，企业内落地会面临合规与信任阻力。

en.highlight: A transparent proxy and live TUI for MCP traffic, pitched as Wireshark for the Model Context Protocol.
en.summary: This is a developer tool that captures and visualizes MCP traffic through a transparent proxy and a live terminal UI, positioned like Wireshark for a protocol. It surfaced on Hacker News with 64 points and 22 comments, a sign that people are already building debugging infrastructure for invisible MCP call chains. Such tools usually appear before commercial value does, and they measure whether a protocol is actually being used at scale.
en.failureAnalysis: Its fate depends almost entirely on MCP adoption; if MCP is a vendor-specific phase, the user base stays small. As a low-price developer debugging tool it is hard to monetize, and once the protocol or its platform vendors ship built-in inspection, third-party tools are easily replaced.
